scope: All five HCC tumor samples 1T-5T, MVI+ and MVI- included without MVI filtering; adjacent NT excluded following preceding tumor-only scope
annotation: Exploratory marker-inferred C1Q-rich macrophage clusters; no author cell annotation supplied by GEO. Not guaranteed to capture C1Q-low macrophages.
annotation_rule: Global Leiden cluster C1QA/B/C each >=75% detection, CSF1R>=60%, TYROBP>=90%, CD1C<40%, FCN1<50%; target-agnostic marker review, PGAM5 excluded from HVG features
clustering: QC all tumor cells, normalize to 10000, log1p, 2000 Seurat HVGs minus PGAM5, 30 PCs, 15 neighbors, igraph Leiden resolution 1, random seed 0
method: Pooled-cell Wilcoxon with tie correction, BH across all genes; no patient pairing, depth matching or patient/sample/MVI/depth covariates
criteria: FDR<0.05, |Scanpy approximate log2FC|>=1, detection>=10% in either group; PGAM5 excluded from candidates
gene_merge: Outer union of Ensembl IDs; missing rows set to zero; symbol from first source annotation. Input feature lists differ.
MVI_note: All five tumors retained. GEO sample characteristics do not provide per-sample MVI labels; no unverified sample-level MVI assignment was inferred.
